title: Make It Count: Text-to-Image Generation with an Accurate Number of Objects
reads: Untrained clustering (DBSCAN) of noisy SDXL self-attention features from layer up-52 at t = 500, inside a foreground mask from the object's cross-attention; no decoded image
trained_on: Counter untrained; ReLayout U-Net trained on about 10,000 SDXL image pairs differing by one object, mapping binary instance masks with k objects to k + 1, Dice plus overlap loss
gradient_enters: Weighted cross-entropy between cross-attention and the target layout at t in [1000, 500], plus self-attention masking at t in [1000, 900]; no update equation or step size printed
unseen: no; ReLayout's training classes are not listed and no held-out classes are tested
headline: Human-rated count accuracy 54% against 26% for SDXL on CoCoCount; at count 2, 30 of 34 images (88%) against about 62% for SDXL, for one repeated class
copy_or_avoid: Copy reading the layout mid-sampling then steering from t = 1000 toward a spatial target; test whether word maps alone can separate instances (inferred)

extra_papers.title: Teaching CLIP to Count to Ten
extra_papers.why: Trains a CLIP model for counting, an abstract property across categories

disagreements.claim: CountGen-Layout improves human accuracy by 14 points (30 to 44) and CountGen-Image by 12
disagreements.paper_says: Table 2 gives 44 for Random layout with CountGen image and 42 for CountGen layout with Bounded Attention, so the attributions are swapped

disagreements.claim: The two components together improve accuracy by 21 points
disagreements.paper_says: Human accuracy moves from 30 to 54, a gain of 24 points; 21 points is the YOLOv9 gain from 29 to 50

disagreements.claim: CountGen is on par with DALL-E 3 for 2 and 3 objects
disagreements.paper_says: The plot shows DALL-E 3 at about 94 against 88 at count 2, and about 79 against 62 at count 3

disagreements.claim: CountGen outperforms all methods under YOLOv9
disagreements.paper_says: At count 10 the plot shows SDXL at about 9% and CountGen at about 6%
